newsitem.title: USA: Hoenig Group adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Hoenig Group adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Hoenig Group Inc said Tuesday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan in which rights will be distributed as a dividend at a rate of one right for each share of common stock.
The right is to be distributed to stockholders of record as of the close of business on January 31.

Hoenig said the rights plan was not adopted in response to any effort by an individual or group to acquire control of the company. However, it said the plan was adopted to deter coercive takeover tactics and to prevent someone from acquiring a controlling interest without offering a fair and adequate price to its stockholders.
The rights are set to expire January 14, 2007.

Each right initially will entitle stockholders to buy one unit of a share of preferred stock for $18. The rights are to be exercisable if a person or group acquired 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
